## Activity

During July 2022, Central Eye Clinic recorded 136 captures. This report summarises activity, image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Capture sessions ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing the number of images available for assessment and the subsequent grading workload.

## Image quality

Of the 136 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.7 per cent. This indicates that almost all captured images were suitable for review, while the ungradable image could not be assessed for grading purposes. The image-quality result is reported separately from the grading outcome to distinguish capture limitations from findings identified during review.

## Grading

Grading identified 31 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 26 days. This measure reflects the time between image capture and completion of grading across the reporting period. Together, the grading volume and median lag provide a summary of the service’s review activity at Central Eye Clinic during July 2022.
